newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Hesse July CPI up 1.6 pct in year.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Hesse July CPI up 1.6 pct in year.

text.p: The statistics Office in the west German state of North Hesse said on Wednesday that the cost of living rose 0.5 percent in July from June for an annual rate of 1.6 percent.
The state in June reported a month-on-month rise of 0.3 percent for an annual rate of 1.5 percent.
Data for four west German states, including Hesse, are used to calculate a preliminary figure for Germany as a whole.
Bavaria is also expected to release its inflation data on Wednesday. North Rhine-Westphalia's data are expected Wednesday or Thursday.
Baden-Wuerttemberg's figures are due out on Friday.
